method: Searched official FFII Pixel Remaster pages, fetched Square Enix-published Steam screenshot URLs through the official Steam appdetails endpoint, downloaded JPEG copies for visual inspection outside Assets, and inspected them with view_image. References inform material density/topology/lighting; no published tile pixels are extracted.

observed: World map green grass repeats without individually framed tiles.
Forest clusters use dark lower shadows and top highlights at stable material scale.
Coast uses a narrow ochre land lip against cobalt water with light blue ripples.
Interior floor is a repeated low-contrast material.
Walls and carpet boundaries use a small consistent thickness; scene scale is stable.
Used only to confirm pixel density and material treatment, not a snow/desert reference.
Blue-green marsh-ground patch transitions to green grass with softly irregular pixel borders.
River shares a narrow ochre shoreline edge and uniform ripple scale.
The center of the biome patch is filled ground texture, not a separate blank island.
Bestiary-map terrain shows repeated forest, grey-ochre mountain masses and grass.
Mountain top highlights and dark lower-facing slopes provide readable height.
Used only for terrain structure/palette rhythm; perspective battle framing and UI are not adopted.

limits: The inspected official screenshots do not directly depict all five new biomes. Snow, sand, ash and cave palette/material choices are original project variations grounded in approved environment sources. No claim of exact original-map reconstruction or seamlessness is made before native patch proofs.
